articles.title: Cabin community to provide 50 homes for unhoused people in Durham Region in 2027
articles.summary: Construction has begun on a cabin community that will provide 50 homes for unhoused people in Durham Region.

articles.title: How Brampton businesses are coping with the delayed Hurontario LRT
articles.summary: The Hurontario LRT is two years overdue. While most of the line is in Mississauga, three stops run through Brampton. And early assessment work is underway for a downtown extension. CBC’s Nav Nanwa checks in on how local businesses are coping with the construction.

articles.title: 2 children among 4 injured in serious Mississauga car crash
articles.summary: Four people were rushed to a hospital on Friday evening after a serious car crash in Mississauga, according to police. articles.title: Coroner's jury deems Jamal Francique's death a homicide, makes 21 recommendations
articles.summary: A coroner's jury has deemed the death of Jamal Francique after an attempt to arrest him a homicide as it made more than 20 recommendations, most of them aimed at Peel regional police.

articles.title: Community holds protest at Finch West TTC station after boy injured in arrest last month

articles.title: Senior dead 2 weeks after being hit by car in Scarborough
articles.summary: An 83-year-old man has died nearly two weeks after he was struck by a driver in a vehicle in Scarborough, Toronto police say. The 60-year-old female driver remained at the scene after the crash, they said.

articles.title: Water service back in downtown Mississauga following repairs to water main break
articles.summary: A water main break in downtown Mississauga that shut down city hall, the Living Arts Centre and Hazel McCallion Central Library on Friday has been repaired, Peel Region officials said early Friday afternoon.

articles.title: Man surrenders to police after fatal stabbing on TTC bus in Scarborough
articles.summary: A man has surrendered to police after a stabbing on a TTC bus in Scarborough left another man dead on Thursday, police say.

articles.title: The crisis at the corner of Queen & Bathurst
articles.summary: Queen and Bathurst feels like ground zero for the city's drug and homelessness crisis. Outreach workers and businesses say it's escalated since the corner's supervised consumption site closed. In this episode of This is Toronto, CBC's Haydn Watters shadows a team responding to overdoses and trying to ease the pain.

articles.title: 2nd suspect arrested in shooting death of woman downtown in June, police say
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested a second suspect in the shooting death of a woman downtown in June.
